About Us:
 LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific.
We're proud to be recognised as a Great Place to Work in 2024.
 Role Summary:
 Do you have a passion for technology? Do you want to learn and make a difference in financial markets infrastructure? We are building a new engineering team, and we are looking for passionate, hands-on technologists to help us lead the way. CDSClear IT is the team behind the technology powering CDSClear - a critical clearing service within the London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG). We are looking for a highly skilled Java Engineer to analyse requirements, design, develop and deliver high quality and well tested Java server side solutions. The role is part of the build out of a new team based in Bucharest. The new team will collaborate with colleagues in London and Paris to deliver innovative solutions.
 What You’ll Be Doing:
 Take ownership within the end-to-end software delivery lifecycle, using Agile or traditional methodologies as needed.
Engineering of Java applications, their tests and supporting infrastructure within development environments.
Analysis of business and functional requirements to design solutions.
Collaborate with global teams on design of application change or that of the supporting infrastructure.
Automation, from testing to deployment, to ensure speed and quality.
Work within a regulated financial environment, with a strong focus on cybersecurity.
Occasional out of hours support for releases or incidents.
 What You’ll Bring:
 5+ years of similar experience
 Experienced with the design and development of Java-based backend services (Spring Boot, microservices architecture) using build tools such as Maven or Gradle.
Exhibit the skills required to engineer services configured to meet corporate standards including those for resilience and information security.
Experience using Ansible to configure and deploy applications.
Linux skills suitable for managing software and debugging issues.
Experience engineering pipelines in CI/CD tools to execute tests and/or deployments.
 It would help us if you have:
 Intermediate level frontend (React and UI/UX) technology skills - e.g. React.js, Typescript, HTML5, CSS3 etc.
Practical experience with Testing frameworks (e.g. Cypress) for automated testing of Web Applications.
Experience of using AI tools to improve development productivity.
Ability to design and develop Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform
Engineered scalable and resilient Kubernetes clusters and supported the configuration of the hosted containerised applications
Familiarity with code and dependency scanning toolsets for SCM, container scanning and static analysis.
Used Artifactory as part of previous SDLC experience.
Experience defining Infrastructure As Code for AWS services such as the following: EC2, RDS, EKS, Lambda, S3, EFS, Managed Kafka, ELB, Route 53 plus other networking services.
Experience of using Terraform in a corporate environment executed via CI/CD pipelines.
